Father

description: Set by the cutting process, not by hand.
label: Is Offcut
name: Item-custom_is_offcut

description: Naming series for batches of this grade. Copied onto every weighed Item in the group, so ERPNext creates batch IDs like PLB-26-00001 automatically.
label: Batch Number Series
name: Item Group-custom_batch_number_series

description: L = Length, W = Width, T = Thickness, MF = Factor. Left blank, this group is an ordinary group and the plate rules do not apply to it. The blank first line is deliberate: without it Frappe uses the first option as the field default, which would put a formula on every Item Group.
label: Formula
name: Item Group-custom_formula

description: Offcuts shorter than this must be booked as scrap. Per grade, because a usable offcut off 2.5 mm plate is not a usable offcut off 25 mm plate. Falls back to Plate Settings when blank.
label: Minimum Offcut Length (mm)
name: Item Group-custom_min_offcut_length_mm

description: Offcuts narrower than this must be booked as scrap. See Minimum Offcut Length. Falls back to Plate Settings when blank.
label: Minimum Offcut Width (mm)
name: Item Group-custom_min_offcut_width_mm

description: Density of this grade, used by the weight formula. Required once a Formula is set. Leave blank and every Item in the group is weighted wrongly.
label: Multiplication Factor (MF)
name: Item Group-custom_multiplication_factor

description: Naming series for serial numbers of this grade. One serial is created per piece.
label: Serial Number Series
name: Item Group-custom_serial_no_series

description: Quantity times the theoretical weight per plate.
label: Estimated Weight (Kg)
name: Purchase Order Item-custom_est_weight_kg

description: One receipt line is one heat number.
label: Heat Number
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_heat_number

description: From the supplier's invoice or challan.
label: Supplier Weight (Kg)
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_supplier_weight_kg

description: Supplier weight against the estimated weight, as a percentage.
label: Variance %
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_variance_pct

label: Weight Decision

Accept Supplier Weight

Accept Weighbridge Weight
